statement: Community emulation describes GET feature 0x20 as a 64-byte firmware/version response; its bytes 44-45 carry a 16-bit feature/update version consumed by SDL, while Linux also parses hardware/firmware fields at bytes 24/28 and update version at 44.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: VIIPER docs 269-280; HHD feature handlers 195-213; Linux 1150-1176; SDL 427-432. Raw firmware strings/build dates vary; this is a community compatibility model plus host parser, not independently authenticated hardware bytes.
